name: Complete 4-Stage Center-Body Torso, 9-Cell Vertical Honeycomb Battery & Electronics Carrier FDM Architecture
user_statement: Looks great alright lets lock that in for the core, commit everything, upload, cleanup. Perform a review and than also mark that task as done.
scope: Selected 4-stage 3D-printable FDM center-body torso, pelvis, 9-cell vertical hexagonal honeycomb battery magazine, and electronics carrier architecture (Stage 1 7-Cell Honeycomb Torso Spine & Hip/Shoulder/Neck Tower, Stage 2 2-Cell Pelvis Column & 7-Cell Upper Battery Retention Lid / 6-Bolt Waist U-Clevis, Stage 3 Dual-Deck Front Power Supervisor & Precharge Frame, Stage 4 Dorsal Body-IMU & Foot-ADC Sensor Carrier) with 86 pressed-in 304 SS compression sleeves (39+11+22+14), 9 direct-on-battery 6063-T5 aluminum 4-blade heat-sink fin strips in full-height vertical window slots, smooth 2-piece continuous 12-station NURBS center shell (center_front_shell + center_back_shell + chest_indicator) bolting directly to flat Stage 1 & Stage 2 mounts, asymmetric 3D edge bevels (r_inner > r_outer), 0.0000 mm^3 overlap across all 25 multi-limb flexion poses, and matched 3D tetrahedral Gmsh FEM across PAHT-CF dry/wet and PETG-CF. Replaces 24 legacy sheet-metal/PA12 torso/pelvis/battery/electronics parts and 3 intermediate pelvis shell-connector brackets. Physical print tolerances, press-fit sleeve retention, bolt preload relaxation, battery thermal duty under enclosed shell gait, and learned-control qualification remain separate.

stage_selection.stage1_center_torso_spine_chassis: Family 1 Blank-Slate 3D Hexagonal Honeycomb & Space-Truss Spine with 7 bottom-loadable vertical 21700 cells, 2 lower-battery top-cap plugs, flat Stage 3/Stage 4/shell mounts, and 39 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (100.66 g total, stall p99=35.81 MPa, u_max=2.6439 mm, 1.55x dry PAHT-CF SF)
stage_selection.stage2_lower_pelvis_battery_cradle: Family 2 3D SIMP Topology-Optimized 2-Cell Lower Pelvis Honeycomb Column with integral 7-cell upper battery-retaining lid, 6-bolt waist U-clevis, flat front/rear pelvis shell mounts, and 11 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (39.01 g total, stall p99=0.67 MPa, u_max=0.0066 mm, 66.7x dry PAHT-CF SF)
stage_selection.stage3_front_power_electronics_carrier: Family 1 Dual-Deck Space-Truss Front Power Supervisor & Main Precharge Carrier with 4 integral rearward standoff brackets and 22 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (23.93 g total, stall p99=12.69 MPa, u_max=0.8438 mm, 4.24x dry PAHT-CF SF)
stage_selection.stage4_rear_imu_adc_carrier: Family 2 3D SIMP Dorsal Body-IMU & Foot-ADC Carrier with 3 vertical dorsal valley standoff rails and 14 pressed-in 304 SS sleeves (14.61 g total, stall p99=2.00 MPa, u_max=0.0179 mm, 26.3x dry PAHT-CF SF)

qualification_limits: Selected FDM center-body torso, 9-cell vertical honeycomb battery, and electronics carrier CAD and linear P1 tetrahedral FEM verification (1g upright, 3g dynamic gait, 6g fall impact, and multi-limb stall across PAHT-CF dry/wet and PETG-CF with 86 bonded 304 SS compression sleeves) plus lumped 12-node thermal/chimney/fin audit. Physical print tolerances, press-fit sleeve retention, bolt preload relaxation, enclosed-shell battery thermal cycling, and learned-control transfer remain unqualified.
